# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

refunded = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']

fraction_converted = converted_count / total_loyal

# Print result
print(f'Converted: {converted_count}, Total loyal: {total_loyal}, Fraction: {fraction_converted:.4f}')

fraction_converted"}
